name: My Sister, My Roommate
source:
You play as Taylor, an introverted 18 year old who is forced to live with his sister Nikki, when they go away to the same college, due to a University housing error. Taylor is a virgin and Nikki is kind of a slut. Can she help get Taylor out of his shell and maybe help him with the ladies?  For Taylor's sake, let's hope so!

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/Sumodeine]Patreon[/url]]
